digest.component_or_area: LLM code-review framework, trigger routing configuration
propositions: The rebar project has high concurrency complexity (multi-process writers, file locks, detached children) making it an ideal dogfood target for trigger over-fire measurement and a load-bearing use case for project-level trigger vocabulary

Project-level noisy-tier trigger tokens (.lock, retry, Popen, fork, etc.) catch 22.0% additional diffs beyond the committed high-precision tier (13.3%), and are necessary to detect three corpus bugs that only trigger through project vocabulary

The two-layer trigger design (committed high-precision tier + project noisy tier merged via effective_routing) must be documented with measured fire-rate tradeoffs and a worked example so other projects can adopt the pattern

Configuration effect must be verifiable: a diff containing index.lock (a project-only token) must fire the concurrency overlay when routing includes this repo's project entry, and not fire under committed-only routing
